content.title: Goldman CEO David Solomon Paid $47 Million
content.summary: Goldman Sachs awarded Chief Executive David Solomon $47 million in compensation for 2025, a 21% raise from the prior year for posting the second-best results in the bank’s history.  The majority is in stock-based compensation tied to future performance.  Goldman’s revenue and profit both rose in 2025 and were second only to the 2021 deal boom.
